info.title: FastHook Control API — Partial contract
info.description: A deliberately partial contract for stable FastHook Control API surfaces. It does not claim coverage of the complete Control API.

excluded: All Control API resources other than project-api-keys, POST /v1/filters/test, the stateless Transformation validate/run endpoints, and Workflow list/detail reads
CLI commands and widget runtime surfaces; synchronized artifacts do not imply owner-session feature support
The hand-authored public documentation OpenAPI document

get.description: Returns at most 100 keys for the selected team without raw credentials or hashes.

403.description: A project owner or site-admin session is required

post.description: Creates a key and returns its raw credential exactly once with Cache-Control: no-store.

403.description: A project owner or site-admin session is required

409.description: The non-revoked key limit was reached

get.description: Returns key metadata without the raw credential or its hash.

403.description: A project owner or site-admin session is required

patch.description: Partially updates mutable metadata and policy. Revoked keys cannot be changed.

403.description: A project owner or site-admin session is required

409.description: Revoked key or gated legacy policy

put.summary: Update a project API key using PUT
put.description: Uses the same partial-update semantics as PATCH; omitted fields retain their current values.

403.description: A project owner or site-admin session is required

409.description: Revoked key or gated legacy policy

delete.summary: Permanently revoke a project API key
delete.description: DELETE is an idempotent permanent revocation and returns the resulting key metadata.

403.description: A project owner or site-admin session is required

409.description: Legacy policy cutover is not complete

post.summary: Permanently revoke a project API key
post.description: Explicit revocation alias for clients that do not use DELETE.

403.description: A project owner or site-admin session is required

409.description: Legacy policy cutover is not complete

get.summary: List project API key audit decisions
get.description: Returns at most 100 coalesced audit decisions for the selected key.

403.description: A project owner or site-admin session is required

post.description: Evaluates filter conditions against a supplied request envelope without storing either value.

403.description: Execute permission or the exact project-key grant is required

put.description: Validates FastHook DSL code and returns its runtime capabilities without executing or storing it.

400.description: Invalid request or unsupported transformation code

403.description: Execute permission or the exact project-key grant is required

put.description: Executes supplied FastHook DSL code against a request envelope without persisting an execution.

400.description: Invalid request or transformation execution failure

403.description: Execute permission or the exact project-key grant is required

get.description: Returns the selected team's bounded Workflow summaries and their currently advertised sequential capabilities.

403.description: Team membership or site-admin access is required

get.description: Returns one Workflow with its editable sequential graph and current runtime capability assessment.

403.description: Team membership or site-admin access is required

SessionBearer.description: Dashboard session bearer token. Project API keys cannot manage project API keys.

ProjectApiKeyBearer.description: Project API key. Only operations declaring this security scheme accept it, subject to scopes and exact execute grants.

TeamId.name: x-team-id
TeamId.description: Team selected for the operation. The authenticated subject must have the role declared by the operation.

api_key.description: Returned only by createProjectApiKey. Store it immediately; it cannot be retrieved later.
